title: Retrievable Gradients: Continual Post-Training Without Cumulative Weight Drift
abstract: arXiv:2606.15734v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Continual post-training enables models to absorb emerging knowledge after deployment, but repeatedly updating shared parameters can accumulate weight drift, potentially causing catastrophic forgetting and degrading general capabilities. Retrieval-augmented generation avoids such parameter drift, yet often lacks the depth of parametric knowledge integration. In this paper, we propose ReGrad (Retrievable Gradients), a new paradigm that treats gradients as retrievable units of knowledge. ReGrad pre-computes document-specific gradients offline, stores them in an indexed Gradient Bank, and retrieves only query-relevant gradients at inference time for temporary weight adaptation. However, raw language-modeling gradients are optimized for token-level document reconstruction rather than for query-driven knowledge use. translated_title: 可检索梯度：无累积权重漂移的持续后训练
translated_abstract: 持续后训练使模型能够在部署后吸收新出现的知识，但反复更新共享参数会累积权重漂移，可能导致灾难性遗忘并降低通用能力。检索增强生成避免了这种参数漂移，但往往缺乏参数化知识整合的深度。在本文中，我们提出了 ReGrad（可检索梯度），这是一种将梯度视为可检索知识单元的新范式。ReGrad 在离线状态下预先计算特定于文档的梯度，将其存储在已建立索引的梯度库中，并在推理时仅检索与查询相关的梯度，用于临时的权重适应。然而，原始的语言建模梯度是为 token 级别的文档重建而优化的，而非为查询驱动的知识使用而优化。因此，我们引入了一个双层元学习目标，将文档衍生的梯度重塑为具有泛化能力的……
tldr: 提出 ReGrad 新范式，将梯度作为可检索的知识单元，通过离线预计算文档梯度存入梯度库、推理时仅检索查询相关梯度进行临时权重适应，并利用双层元学习目标重塑梯度的泛化能力，从而实现无累积权重漂移的持续后训练。
en_tdlr: ReGrad introduces a new paradigm that treats gradients as retrievable knowledge units—pre-computing document-specific gradients offline in an indexed Gradient Bank and retrieving only query-relevant gradients for temporary weight adaptation at inference—enabled by a bi-level meta-learning objective that reshapes gradients for generalization, thereby achieving continual post-training without cumulative weight drift.
